map.EPT 和财务回收期哪个长？: Which is longer, EPT or financial payback period?
map.通常财务回收期更长（受电价与初投影响），EPT 仅看能量，是环境可持续性的指标。: Usually financial payback is longer (affected by tariff and initial investment); EPT only looks at energy and is an environmental sustainability metric.
map.制造工艺能耗、系统寿命、当地辐照/风资源；高资源区 EPT 更短。: Manufacturing energy, system lifespan, local irradiance/wind resources; high-resource areas have shorter EPT.
